sentences.en: I breathed the smell of the flowers in the garden.
sentences.zh: 我吸进了花园里花朵的气息。

sentences.en: They were out of breath after swimming across the river.
sentences.zh: 他们游过河后气喘吁吁。

sentences.en: He ran so fast that he was out of breath.
sentences.zh: 他跑得太快以至于上气不接下气。

senses.zh: 呼吸，气息；一口气，（呼吸的）一次；瞬间，瞬息；微风；迹象；无声音，气音
